community_count.source: 在线访客按最近90秒活跃的浏览器估算，同一浏览器多个标签页计为一个。
community_count.en: Estimated browsers active in the last 90 seconds. Multiple tabs in one browser count once.

community_privacy.source: 无需登录。后台记录IP用于访问日志和限流，日志保留7天，不公开显示。
community_privacy.en: No sign-in. IP addresses are logged privately for access monitoring and rate limits, and retained for 7 days.

community_paused.source: 队列暂停，等待服务检查

community_empty.source: 当前浏览器暂无计算任务
community_empty.en: No computation tasks in this browser

community_position.source: 数字为等待队列中的位置，按提交顺序执行。
community_position.en: The number is your position in the waiting queue. Tasks run in submission order.

community_restart.source: 服务重启中断了计算，可重新提交
community_restart.en: Computation was interrupted by a service restart. Submit again to retry.

community_rate.source: 提交过于频繁，请一分钟后重试
community_rate.en: Too many requests. Try again in one minute.

community_max.source: 当前浏览器最多保留{{0}}个未完成任务
community_max.en: This browser can keep up to {{0}} unfinished tasks.

community_network_max.source: 同一网络最多保留{{0}}个未完成任务，请等前面的任务完成
community_network_max.en: One network can keep up to {{0}} unfinished tasks. Wait for earlier tasks to finish.

community_names_hourly.source: 同一网络一小时内最多新建60组电极名称，请稍后再试
community_names_hourly.en: One network can create at most 60 electrode-name sets per hour. Try again later.

community_maintenance.source: 服务维护中，已有结果仍可读取；请稍后提交新计算
community_maintenance.en: The service is under maintenance. Existing results remain readable; submit new computations later.

community_refresh_retry.en: Refresh the page and try again.

server_busy.source: 服务器正忙，请稍后重试
server_busy.en: The server is busy. Try again later.

server_internal.source: 服务器内部错误，已记录；请稍后重试
server_internal.en: Internal server error. It has been logged; try again later.

server_bad_json.en: The request body is not valid JSON.

reception_saved_layout_invalid.source: 保存的信号布局坐标或区域标签无效
reception_saved_layout_invalid.en: The saved signal layout has invalid coordinates or region labels.

decision_restored_job.source: 已恢复离开前提交的坐标评价，正在继续查询进度。
decision_restored_job.en: Restored the coordinate evaluation submitted before you left; still checking its progress.

design_expand_to_compute.source: 展开调整参数并开始计算
design_expand_to_compute.en: Expand to adjust parameters and start a computation

community_full.source: 队列已满，请稍后提交；已有结果仍可读取
community_full.en: The queue is full. Submit later; saved results remain available.

community_missing.source: 任务不存在或不属于当前浏览器
community_missing.en: Task not found or not owned by this browser.

community_unsubscribe.source: 已退出共享任务，其他访客的计算继续
community_unsubscribe.en: You left the shared task. Computation continues for other visitors.

community_changed.source: 模型或代码已更新，请重新提交
community_changed.en: The model or code has changed. Submit again.

community_changed_queue.source: 排队后模型或代码已更新，请重新提交
community_changed_queue.en: The model or code changed while queued. Submit again.

community_unavailable.source: 计算队列不可用，请稍后重试
community_unavailable.en: The computation queue is unavailable. Try again later.

community_record.source: 计算记录无法读取，请重新提交
community_record.en: The saved result cannot be read. Submit again.

community_occupied.source: 计算资源被其他进程占用，请重新提交
community_occupied.en: Another process is using the computation resource. Submit again.

workspace13.source: 电极编辑副本 · 与原布局分开评价
workspace13.en: Electrode-edit copy · evaluated separately from its source

workspace14.source: 当前草稿 · 尚无匹配的布局评价
workspace14.en: Current draft · no matching layout evaluation

workspace16.en: Current record could not be loaded

workspace19.source: 编辑结果不进入固定64点信号协议
workspace19.en: Edited results use a separate protocol from fixed-64 signal simulation

workspace21.source: 导入已有64点坐标，评价后保存为独立布局；不运行区域布局搜索。
workspace21.en: Import 64 electrode coordinates and evaluate them as a separate layout, without running a region-layout search.

workspace23.source: 固定所选布局，检查网格位置偏移前后的重建表现；外部坐标在布局设计的坐标导入中评价。
workspace23.en: Keep the selected layout fixed and compare reconstruction before and after grid displacements. Evaluate external coordinates under Layout Design → Coordinate Import.

workspace25.source: 指定记录不支持此工具，请重新选择布局。
workspace25.en: The specified record is not supported by this tool. Select another layout.

workspace26.source: 已恢复本标签页的电极草稿；尚未重新评价。
workspace26.en: Restored this tab’s electrode draft; it has not been re-evaluated.

workspace27.source: 已恢复坐标草稿；尚未重新评价。
workspace27.en: Coordinate draft restored; it has not been re-evaluated.

workspace28.source: 从结果库查看已有实验；在布局设计中设置区域、编辑电极或导入坐标；在信号仿真中比较接收波形。使用指南与建模原理分别阅读。
workspace28.en: Explore existing experiments in Results Library; define regions, edit electrodes or import coordinates in Layout Design; compare received waveforms in Signal Simulation. The User Guide and Models & Methods remain separate documents.

workspace29.source: 坐标导入只执行当前坐标评价；位置偏移测试位于结果库的方案对比。
workspace29.en: Coordinate Import evaluates the current coordinates. Position displacement tests are available under Results Library → Layout Comparison.

workspace30.source: 坐标草稿无法恢复，请重新导入文件。
workspace30.en: The coordinate draft could not be restored. Import the file again.

workspace31.source: 当前标签页无法暂存坐标；离开前请保留原始文件。
workspace31.en: This tab cannot keep a temporary coordinate draft. Keep the original file before leaving.

workspace32.source: 电极草稿无法恢复，已载入所选布局。
workspace32.en: The electrode draft could not be restored. The selected layout has been loaded.

workspace33.source: 当前标签页无法暂存电极草稿；请手动保存后离开。
workspace33.en: This tab cannot keep a temporary electrode draft. Save it manually before leaving.

workspace34.source: 在结果库的“方案对比”中选择A、B，核对协议、实际面积与允许位置范围，再设置各项性能要求。可导出Markdown报告、完整JSON及64点CSV坐标。外部坐标文件在布局设计的“坐标导入”中评价；位置偏移测试保留在方案对比。
workspace34.en: Select layouts A and B under Results Library → Layout Comparison, check their protocols, actual areas and placement constraints, then set each performance requirement. Export a Markdown report, full JSON or 64-point CSV coordinates. Evaluate external coordinate files under Layout Design → Coordinate Import; position displacement tests remain in Layout Comparison.

workspace35.source: 已有电极坐标时，可直接进入坐标导入，上传CSV或JSON并评价；不必先运行区域布局搜索。
workspace35.en: If you already have electrode coordinates, open Coordinate Import, upload CSV or JSON and evaluate them directly, without first running a region-layout search.

allocation_adaptive_full.source: 跨区自适应配额（每区≥4，共64）
allocation_adaptive_full.en: Adaptive cross-region quota (min 4 per region, 64 total)

allocation_hint_adaptive.source: 每区至少保留 4 个锚点电极，其余通道按有效孔径与信噪比跨区自动调配。
allocation_hint_adaptive.en: Preserves at least 4 anchor electrodes per region and reallocates remaining channels across regions by effective aperture and SNR.

allocation_hint_balanced.source: 固定按 64/R 均分各区电极数，与面积和历史基线口径一致。
allocation_hint_balanced.en: Fixes 64/R electrodes per region, matching the area-budget and baseline protocol.

allocation_err_mode.source: 区域通道配额模式无效

allocation_err_single.source: 单区域不支持跨区自适应配额
allocation_err_single.en: Single-region layouts do not support adaptive cross-region quota.

allocation_progress_waterfill.source: 跨区信息配额注水初始化 {{0}}/{{1}}

fedorov_progress_round.source: 收敛交换与中心重填（起点 {{0}}/{{1}} · 第 {{2}} 轮）

objective_hint_composite.source: 联合优化下尾保留率、全脑场保留率与63维子空间互信息（0.55·min + 0.30·场 + 0.15·信息），为贴片内部电极提供持续空间去相关梯度。
objective_hint_composite.en: Jointly optimizes lower-tail retention, field retention and 63D subspace mutual information (0.55·min + 0.30·field + 0.15·info), providing continuous spatial decorrelation gradients for interior electrodes.

objective_hint_min.source: 最大化场重建与双极幅值下10%分位数的较小值 min(场, 幅值)，与默认基线完全一致。
objective_hint_min.en: Maximizes min(field, amplitude lower-10% tail), matching the default baseline protocol.

objective_err_mode.source: 搜索优化目标模式无效

electrode_count_hint.source: 默认64导（与标准全头64导参考基线一致）；指定更少导联（如8、16、24、32导）可在固定贴片半径下测试通道饱和拐点。
electrode_count_hint.en: Default 64 channels (matching the full-scalp standard64 baseline); specify fewer channels (e.g., 8, 16, 24, 32) to map channel-saturation knees under a fixed patch radius.

allocation_hint_balanced_k.source: 固定按 K/R 均分各区电极数，与面积和历史基线口径一致。
allocation_hint_balanced_k.en: Fixes K/R electrodes per region, matching the area-budget and baseline protocol.

electrode_count_err_allowed.en: Total electrode count only supports 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, or 64.

electrode_count_err_adaptive.source: 跨区自适应配额要求电极总数至少为每区4导
electrode_count_err_adaptive.en: Adaptive cross-region quota requires at least 4 electrodes per region.

electrode_count_err_balanced.source: 电极总数不足以分配到所选区域数（每区至少2导）
electrode_count_err_balanced.en: Total electrode count is too small for the selected region count (at least 2 per region).

design_pending_no_layout_k.source: 本次搜索未找到完整布局。可扩大半径、减少电极总数或调整位置范围后再次计算。
design_pending_no_layout_k.en: No complete layout was found in this search. Increase the radius, lower the electrode count, or adjust the allowed placement domain and retry.

worker_no_layout_k.source: 在当前候选网格、4mm间距和有限搜索预算内，未构造出满足严格区域约束的{{0}}点布局；这不是数学不可行证明。
worker_no_layout_k.en: Within the current candidate grid, 4 mm spacing, and bounded search budget, no {{0}}-electrode layout satisfying strict region constraints was constructed; this does not certify mathematical infeasibility.

design_limits_variable_k.source: 支持8–64导（默认64导） · 最小电极直线间距4 mm · 单Ernie头模 · 标准64导名义SNR＝20 dB。各布局使用相同物理噪声尺度。算法在有限候选网格内搜索，位置范围按模型坐标近似定义。
design_limits_variable_k.en: Supports 8–64 channels (default 64) · minimum straight-line electrode spacing of 4 mm · one Ernie head model · nominal standard-64 SNR = 20 dB. All layouts use the same physical noise scale. The algorithm searches a finite candidate grid; placement domains are approximated using model coordinates.

design_next_sparse_k.source: 布局详情汇总这个布局在各条件下的评价并支持双栏对比；信号仿真与电极编辑仅适用于默认协议下的64导布局。
design_next_sparse_k.en: The layout’s page gathers its evaluations under every condition and supports side-by-side comparison; signal simulation and electrode editing apply only to 64-channel layouts under the default protocol.

design_next_empty_k.source: 计算出完整布局后，可打开布局详情、加入方案对比，或在64导默认协议下用同一脑源测试。
design_next_empty_k.en: Once a complete layout is computed, open its page, compare it with another layout, or test it with the same brain sources under the default 64-channel protocol.

saved_details_sparse_k.source: 此布局为少于64导方案，支持三维查看、导出与双栏方案对比；电极编辑与信号仿真仅适用于64导布局。
saved_details_sparse_k.en: This layout uses fewer than 64 channels and supports 3D viewing, export, and side-by-side comparison; electrode editing and signal simulation apply only to 64-channel layouts.

home_start_lead_k.source: 把电极集中放在头上少数几个区域（默认64导，支持8–64导探索），相比标准64导全头布置还能保留多少信号？本应用用头模仿真回答这个问题，并帮你设计、评价和比较这样的布局。
home_start_lead_k.en: If electrodes are concentrated in a few regions of the head (default 64 channels, with 8–64-channel exploration), how much signal do they keep compared with the standard whole-head 64-electrode layout? This application answers that by head-model simulation, and helps you design, evaluate and compare such layouts.

home_start_design_k.source: 选择头部部位、区域数、电极总数（8–64导）和每区大小，搜索布局并评价。
home_start_design_k.en: Choose the head locations, region count, total electrodes (8–64 channels), and each region's size, then search for a layout and evaluate it.

home_new_search_k.source: 选择部位、区域数、电极总数（默认64导）和每区半径，搜索最优布局。
home_new_search_k.en: Choose sites, the number of regions, total electrodes (default 64), and the radius per region to search for a layout.

decision_compare_intro_k.source: 选择两个已保存布局（支持8–64导及跨区自适应配额），并排核对约束、空间分布与三项保留率；64导均衡方案还可检查网格位置偏移。
decision_compare_intro_k.en: Select two saved layouts (supporting 8–64 channels and adaptive regional quotas), compare constraints, spatial geometry and retention metrics side by side, and test grid position shifts on 64-channel equal-split designs.

decision_offset_fixed64_only.source: 仅64导均衡方案支持偏移测试

decision_offset_blocked_k.source: 当前所选方案使用少于64导或跨区自适应配额；上方已完成并排性能与空间对比，下方跨条件坐标评价与网格偏移仅适用于均衡分配的64电极方案。
decision_offset_blocked_k.en: The selected layout uses fewer than 64 channels or an adaptive cross-region quota; side-by-side metric and spatial comparison is shown above, while coordinate re-evaluation and grid-shift tests below apply only to equal-split 64-electrode designs.

decision_note_electrode_count.source: 电极总数不同：比较的是通道规模与空间分布的共同影响（均相对标准全头64导评分）。
decision_note_electrode_count.en: Total electrode counts differ: this compares the joint effect of channel count and spatial placement (both scored relative to whole-head standard64).

decision_note_allocation_mode.source: 区域通道配额方式不同（均分与跨区自适应）：各区通道数随有效孔径变化。
decision_note_allocation_mode.en: Regional channel quota modes differ (equal split vs adaptive cross-region): per-region channel counts vary with effective aperture.

decision_md_electrodes_basis_k.source: 各方案测量电极数见下表（8–64导）；参照均为Ernie头模上的BioSemi64标签匹配全头布局。
decision_md_electrodes_basis_k.en: Each layout's measurement electrode count (8–64 channels) is listed below; all are referenced to the BioSemi64 label-matched whole-head layout on Ernie.

decision_md_header_k.source: |方案|电极数|区域数|实际面积 cm²|重建保留率|幅度保留率（最差10%）|相对定位评分|定位中位数|定位P90|条件判定|
decision_md_header_k.en: |Layout|Electrodes|Regions|Actual area, cm²|Reconstruction retention|Amplitude retention (lowest 10%)|Relative Localization Utility|Median localization error|Localization P90|Criteria assessment|

figure_err_coords.source: 布局图需要2–64个有效三维坐标。

figure_err_dup.en: Layout figure coordinates must be distinct.

figure_err_regions.source: 布局图需要匹配的区域标签。
figure_err_regions.en: Layout figure requires matching region labels.

figure_err_names.source: 电极名称数量须与坐标一致。
figure_err_names.en: Electrode name count must match the coordinates.

existing.source: 总面积约束 · 已计算数据

new.source: 每区半径约束 · 新建设计

question.source: 64个电极，集中布置后还能保留多少信号？
question.en: How much signal can 64 electrodes retain when concentrated into fewer regions?

read_only.source: 切换以上条件只读取已有结果。单Ernie头模 · 标准64导名义SNR 20 dB。
read_only.en: These controls select saved results. One Ernie head model · nominal 20 dB SNR at the standard 64 electrodes.

table.source: 相同面积上限下，几个区域更合适？
table.en: Compare region counts under the same area limit

curve.source: 曲线阈值线对应当前所选指标；下方结论要求三项指标均达到最低保留要求。
curve.en: The chart threshold applies to the selected metric. The conclusions below require all three metrics to meet the minimum retention requirement.

scope.source: 本页实验条件与阅读说明

whole_scope.source: 全头候选区：不限制毛发位置，由算法选择区域。
whole_scope.en: Whole-scalp candidates: no hair-location restriction; the algorithm selects the regions.

hair_scope.source: 少毛发候选区：耳后、前额与眶周的模型近似范围，不包含完整扩展耳周。
hair_scope.en: Low-hair candidates: model-defined approximations behind the ears, on the forehead and around the eyes; the full extended ear region is excluded.

queue_ahead.source: 前方等待任务：{{0}}项；按提交顺序执行。
queue_ahead.en: {{0}} waiting tasks ahead; executed in submission order.

requirements_joint.source: 三项共同要求（与实验总览一致）
requirements_joint.en: Shared requirement for all three metrics (same as overview)

requirements_joint_threshold.en: Minimum retention for all three metrics (%)

requirements_joint_summary.source: 三项共同要求：场重建、幅度和定位效用保留率均不低于{{0}}%。
requirements_joint_summary.en: Shared requirement: field reconstruction, amplitude, and localization utility retention must each be at least {{0}}%.

requirements_note.source: 修改要求只重新判断现有指标，不启动计算。自定义模式下，留空的指标不参与判定。
requirements_note.en: Changing requirements only reassesses existing metrics; it does not start a computation. Blank limits are not checked in individual mode.

requirements_guide.source: 已有结果、布局设计和方案对比默认要求三项保留率都达到同一最低要求，G为三项最低值。方案对比和坐标评价可切换为自定义要求，分别设置场重建、幅度、定位效用或毫米误差上限；留空的指标不参与判定。修改要求只重新判断已有数值，不改变点位、不重新计算。
requirements_guide.en: Results, Layout Design, and Compare Layouts require all three retention metrics to meet the same minimum by default; G is their minimum. Compare Layouts and coordinate evaluation can use individual limits for field reconstruction, amplitude, localization utility, or error in millimeters. Blank limits are not checked. Changing requirements only reassesses existing values; it does not move electrodes or rerun computation.

joint_area_assessment.en: Joint assessment across all three metrics

historical_signal_availability.source: 此历史协议的记录仅供查看与导出。信号仿真支持当前总面积布局、半径计算布局和已评价坐标布局。
historical_signal_availability.en: Records from this historical protocol are available for viewing and export. Signal simulation supports current area-constrained layouts, computed radius-constrained layouts, and evaluated coordinate layouts.

placement_load_failed.source: 部位组合未载入，可进入布局设计重新读取。
placement_load_failed.en: Placement combinations could not be loaded. Open Layout Design to reload them.

negative_reconstruction_both.source: 两套布局的重建解释率均为负。
negative_reconstruction_both.en: Both layouts have negative reconstruction explained energy.

negative_reconstruction_explanation.source: 重建误差超过干净信号功率，当前相对保留率无法定义。
negative_reconstruction_explanation.en: Reconstruction error exceeds clean signal power, so relative retention is undefined.

relative_retention_undefined.source: 当前相对保留率无法定义。

baseline_not_valid.source: 标准布局的重建解释率非正或过小，无法作为有效的相对比较基准。
baseline_not_valid.en: The standard layout has nonpositive or near-zero explained energy and cannot serve as a valid reference for relative comparison.

negative_candidate_reconstruction.source: 自定义布局的重建解释率为负。
negative_candidate_reconstruction.en: The custom layout has negative reconstruction explained energy.

negative_candidate_explanation.source: 自定义布局的重建误差超过干净信号功率。原始评分保留在下表中。
negative_candidate_explanation.en: The custom layout reconstruction error exceeds clean signal power. The original scores remain in the table below.

view_clean_condition.en: View condition without cardiac or ocular artifacts

ui_placement_step1.source: 1 · 选择区域数与布置方式

ui_placement_whole_note.source: 不限制毛发位置，由算法选择区域。
ui_placement_whole_note.en: No hair-location restriction; the algorithm selects the regions.

ui_placement_low_hair_note.source: 只在耳后、前额与眶周的近似少毛发范围内选择。
ui_placement_low_hair_note.en: Only within the approximate low-hair areas behind the ears, on the forehead and around the eyes.

ui_placement_regions_note.source: 为每个区域指定部位：选常用组合，或逐区自由组合。
ui_placement_regions_note.en: Name a location for every region: pick a common combination or choose each region freely.

ui_design_empty.source: 计算完成后，这里显示三项保留率与达标判断。
ui_design_empty.en: After the calculation, the three retention scores and the pass/fail judgment appear here.

ui_start_compare.source: 比较1–6个区域在相同面积下保留多少信号。
ui_start_compare.en: Compare how much signal 1–6 regions keep under the same area.

ui_start_design_note.source: 选择部位和每区半径，计算并保存新的64电极布局。
ui_start_design_note.en: Choose locations and a radius per region, then calculate and save a new 64-electrode layout.

ui_start_reception_note.source: 用同一模拟脑源，对照标准64导与新布局的接收信号。
ui_start_reception_note.en: Use the same simulated brain source to compare what standard 64 channels and the new layout receive.

guide_purpose.en: Compare how 64 electrodes gathered into a few regions record relative to the standard full-head 64-channel layout. The interface has five areas, in order from left to right in the top bar.

guide_findings.source: 先看已发表的结果：相同面积上限下，区域越少，保留的信号越少吗？比较前先核对实验协议、面积或半径约束，以及电极总数。
guide_findings.en: Start with the published results: under the same area cap, do fewer regions keep less signal? Before comparing, check the protocol, the area or radius constraint, and the electrode count.

guide_design.source: 依次选择允许布置范围、区域数量和每区半径上限，再点击计算；已有电极坐标时，直接进入坐标导入。尚未生成完整布局时，扩大半径或调整区域后重试。
guide_design.en: Choose the allowed placement range, the number of regions and the radius cap per region, then calculate; with existing electrode coordinates, go straight to coordinate import. If no complete layout is constructed, widen the radius or adjust the regions and try again.

guide_layouts.source: 布局列表每个布局一行；“查看布局”打开详情页，从那里发起评价、对比、研究、信号仿真、编辑和导出。
guide_layouts.en: The layout list has one row per layout; “View layout” opens its page, where evaluations, comparisons, studies, signal simulation, editing and export start.

guide_compare.source: 方案对比先选布局，再选评价条件；结论栏先说明两个布局是否达到要求以及相差多少，详细指标在下方。
guide_compare.en: Compare Layouts asks for a layout, then for an evaluation condition; the conclusion bar first says whether each layout meets the requirement and how far apart they are, with the detailed metrics below.

guide_reception.source: 比较同一场景下的标准64导、当前布局接收信号和重建结果。编辑后的减导记录不进入此实验。
guide_reception.en: Compare the signals received by standard64 and by the current layout, and their reconstruction, in the same scenario. Edited records with fewer channels do not enter this experiment.

guide_projects.source: 研究项目把多个布局、对比和交付包放在一起，便于导出和交给合作者。方案对比支持报告、JSON和坐标CSV导出。
guide_projects.en: A research project keeps several layouts, comparisons and delivery packages together, ready to export and hand to collaborators. Compare Layouts exports a report, JSON and coordinate CSV.

guide_intro.source: 工作区汇总最近的工作；布局板块新建和查找布局；分析板块提出问题；研究结果是已发表的实验；文档包括本指南与建模原理。
guide_intro.en: The workspace gathers recent work; Layouts creates and finds layouts; Analysis asks questions; Findings holds the published experiments; Documentation has this guide and the methods.

usage_1.source: 工作区：最近的布局、计算任务、研究和项目。布局：新建布局（区域设计、坐标导入、电极编辑）和布局列表。分析：方案对比、稳健性研究、信号仿真和通道子集。研究结果：已发表的总面积研究与历史批次。文档：本指南与建模原理。
usage_1.en: Workspace: recent layouts, computation tasks, studies and projects. Layouts: new layouts (region design, coordinate import, electrode editing) and the layout list. Analysis: Compare Layouts, robustness studies, signal simulation and channel subsets. Findings: the published total-area study and the historical batches. Documentation: this guide and the methods.

usage_2.source: 总面积研究比较相同总面积上限下1、2、3、4、6个区域各保留多少信号。选择一行查看点位与三项保留率；查看、筛选和调整AR不会启动新计算。
usage_2.en: The total-area study compares how much signal 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 regions keep under the same total-area cap. Choose a row to see its electrode positions and three retentions; viewing, filtering and changing the minimum required retention start no new calculation.

usage_3.source: 区域设计固定64点并按区域均衡分配，按每区半径上限搜索；坐标导入读取已有电极坐标并在当前条件下评价；电极编辑从已有布局删减或移动点位，另存为编辑副本。新结果自动保存，相同配置优先直接读取。
usage_3.en: Region design fixes 64 points, shares them evenly among the regions and searches under a radius cap per region; coordinate import reads existing electrode coordinates and evaluates them under the current conditions; electrode editing removes or moves points of an existing layout and saves an edited copy. New results are saved automatically, and a configuration already computed is read back.

usage_4.source: 每个布局一页：同一组坐标在不同噪声模型、电导率、头模或数据先验下的评价排成一张表，名义Ernie评价在前。不同条件的分数只与相同条件比较。
usage_4.en: Each layout has one page: evaluations of the same coordinates under different noise models, conductivities, heads or data priors form one table, the nominal Ernie evaluation first. Scores are compared only within the same condition.

usage_5_title.source: 5. 一个问题，一次操作或一项研究
usage_5_title.en: 5. One question: an action or a study

usage_5.source: 一次请求就能回答的问题是一个操作：在其他条件下评价、位置偏移测试、与另一个布局对比。需要多次请求的问题是稳健性研究：按随机种子、头模或网格位移重复评价并汇总。
usage_5.en: A question one request can answer is an action: an evaluation under other conditions, a position displacement test, a comparison with another layout. A question that needs several requests is a robustness study: evaluations repeated over random seeds, heads or grid displacements and summarized together.

usage_6.source: 先选一个完整的64点布局，再设置脑源位置、波形和模拟干扰。布局坐标固定；此页比较所选场景下标准64导与当前布局的接收波形和信号重建。只有独立噪声下得到的布局进入信号仿真。
usage_6.en: Choose a complete 64-point layout, then set the source location, waveform and simulated interference. The coordinates stay fixed; the page compares the waveforms received by standard64 and by the current layout, and their reconstruction, in the chosen scenario. Only layouts obtained under independent noise enter signal simulation.

usage_7_title.en: 7. The three retentions and the minimum requirement

usage_7.source: 与同一协议下的标准全头64导比较。信号重建保留率衡量恢复全头信号的能力；幅度保留率（最差10%）取相对损失最大的10%源面积权重的幅度比；相对定位评分由误差换算。默认三项都要达到同一最低要求AR；修改AR只重新判断已有数值，不改变点位、不重新计算。
usage_7.en: Each is compared with the standard full-head 64-channel layout under the same protocol. Field reconstruction retention measures how well the full-head signal is recovered; amplitude retention (worst 10%) is the amplitude ratio over the 10% of source area with the largest relative loss; the relative localization score is derived from the error. By default all three must reach the same minimum required retention; changing it only re-judges existing values and neither moves points nor recalculates.

findings_batches_intro.source: 两个早期批次按各自协议保留，只读查看；它们的分数只评价各自的布局，不与本页结果混合。
findings_batches_intro.en: Two early batches are kept under their own protocols, read-only. Their scores qualify only their own layouts and are not mixed with the results on this page.

findings_radius_protocol.source: 每区半径上限，区域允许相交 · 单Ernie头模
findings_radius_protocol.en: Radius cap per region, regions may overlap · Ernie head only

findings_pilot_protocol.source: 两个32电极区域按几何规则构造，未做优化 · 单Ernie头模
findings_pilot_protocol.en: Two regions of 32 electrodes built by geometric rules, not optimized · Ernie head only

start_lead.source: 把64个电极集中放在头上少数几个区域，相比标准64导全头布置还能保留多少信号？本应用用头模仿真回答这个问题，并帮你设计、评价和比较这样的布局。
start_lead.en: If the 64 electrodes are concentrated in a few regions of the head, how much signal do they keep compared with the standard whole-head 64-electrode layout? This application answers that by head-model simulation, and helps you design, evaluate and compare such layouts.

start_findings_text.source: 浏览总面积研究：1–6个区域在不同面积上限下各保留多少信号。只读，不需要计算。
start_findings_text.en: Browse the total-area study: how much signal 1–6 regions keep under each area cap. Read-only; nothing is computed.

start_coordinates.source: 评价我已有的电极位置

start_coordinates_text.source: 导入CSV、JSON、BIDS、.elc或.sfp坐标文件，或按10-05电极名称导入，得到三项保留率。
start_coordinates_text.en: Import a CSV, JSON, BIDS, .elc or .sfp coordinate file, or 10-05 electrode names, and get the three retention scores.

start_design_text.source: 选择头部部位、区域数和每区大小，搜索64电极布局并评价。
start_design_text.en: Choose the head locations, the number of regions and each region's size, then search for a 64-electrode layout and evaluate it.

start_example_text.source: 一个已在多种条件下评价过的布局，可以先看看完整的结果页面。
start_example_text.en: A layout evaluated under several conditions, to see what a full results page looks like.

start_score_ratio.source: 保留率 = 布局的得分 ÷ 标准64导全头布置的得分；100%表示与全头64导相同。
start_score_ratio.en: Retention = the layout's score ÷ the score of the standard whole-head 64-electrode layout; 100% means the same as whole-head 64.

start_score_metrics.source: 三项保留率分别回答：标准64导记录到的头皮电场能重建多少（场重建）；损失最多的10%脑源还能记录到多大的电位差（幅度）；源定位与标准64导相比如何（定位效用）。
start_score_metrics.en: The three retentions answer: how much of the scalp field recorded by standard64 can be reconstructed (field reconstruction); how large a potential difference the 10% of sources that lose the most can still produce (amplitude); and how source localization compares with standard64 (localization utility).

start_score_ar.source: 最低保留要求是你设定的合格线：三项保留率都达到它才算合格。调整它只重新判断，不重新计算。
start_score_ar.en: The minimum required retention is your pass line: a layout passes when all three retentions reach it. Changing it re-judges the results without recomputing them.
